item.title: Papa Murphy’s Launches its First-Ever Detroit-Style Pizza | RestaurantNews.com
item.description: The crunch you've been waiting for is here! Papa Murphy's just launched its first-ever Detroit-Style pizza. Get those crispy edges fresh from your oven!

item.title: Huckleberry’s Breakfast & Lunch Accelerates Texas Expansion | RestaurantNews.com
item.description: More bayou vibes are coming to Texas! Huckleberry's Breakfast & Lunch is expanding into Austin and adding new spots in McKinney and Allen.

item.title: The Great Greek Mediterranean Grill Expands in Utah with New Layton Location | RestaurantNews.com
item.description: The Great Greek Mediterranean Grill is officially coming to Layton’s Restaurant Row! Experience authentic family recipes, from steak souvlaki to baklava ice cream, starting this April.

item.title: Bobby’s Burgers by Bobby Flay Continues Expansion in Utah with New Holladay Opening | RestaurantNews.com
item.description: Get ready, Holladay! Bobby's Burgers by Bobby Flay is bringing the Bacon Crunchburger and signature shakes to Holladay Hill. Stop by for an unbeatable burger experience.

item.title: Teriyaki Madness Expands to Long Island with Opening of North Babylon Location | RestaurantNews.com
item.description: Long Island just got a whole lot bolder! Teriyaki Madness is officially open in North Babylon, serving up $6 bowls and a chance to win free food for a year.

item.title: Chili Shack Appoints New COO Amid National Expansion | RestaurantNews.com
item.description: Chili Shack has appointed a new COO to lead its national expansion and oversee the launch of 100 new franchise locations across the United States.

item.description: Taco Cabana tests authentic Mexican flavors, SONIC debuts real fruit Refreshers, Mountain Mike's Pizza launches a Garlic Parm Stuffed Crustm and more in this week's restaurant menu news.

item.description: Feng Cha and Boba Cucue are rapidly expanding their boba tea footprints while Pepper Lunch brings its DIY teppanyaki to Phoenix. Check out the latest restaurant franchise news.

item.description: April Restaurant Deals are officially here to brighten up the spring season. Explore a full month of brunch specials, holiday feasts, and game-day catering options.

item.title: Jersey Mike’s Donates All Sales To 2026 Special Olympics USA Games Wednesday, March 25 | RestaurantNews.com
item.description: Every sub counts! This Wednesday, Jersey Mike's is donating 100% of sales to the 2026 Special Olympics USA Games. Join the movement and help support over 3,000 athletes.
